claims: Claude Fable 5 can now build websites 'people are charging $10,000 for' — cinematic 3D scrolling sites like Apple's homepage

Works for a luxury watch brand, personal portfolio, or a fictional business
how_to_steps: Switch Claude Code to Fable 5 and set reasoning to extra high or max
Connect the Higgsfield MCP so Claude can generate images and videos
Give one prompt describing the site (template shown: 'Build a website for my [business type]. Use [reference]...')
Tell Claude to generate all media using Seedance 2.0 and let it build the whole site

relevance.why: Same stack as the chase_ai_ video but compressed into a funnel; the only actionable bits are 'max reasoning for front-end builds' and Higgsfield MCP for assets. The $10k claim is marketing.

implement_score.why: Trying max reasoning plus a strong single prompt with reference URL costs nothing; Higgsfield MCP adds real asset generation but paid credits. Expect several iterations, not one-shot.
